headline: Co-Fabric reports cross-host xPU fabric gains on a 64-device system
summary: A September 2026 preprint describes Co-Fabric, a bus-based xPU interconnect that uses hardware port-ID routing and shadow-device enumeration to present a unified address space across host domains. On a reported 64-xPU 3D-mesh testbed, the authors report lower communication latency and higher bandwidth than their RoCE comparison system, plus faster DeepSeek R1 inference. These are single-paper results on a custom system; independent reproduction and transfer to other hardware are not established.
